suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 (CVSS 9.8): unsafe deserialization of Kotlin *build cache metadata*, i.e. the Kotlin compiler / build tooling. The CPE cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin matches every org.jetbrains.kotlin jar, so the runtime standard library is flagged too, but the stdlib never reads build caches and this project does not compile Kotlin. The jars come in transitively: spring-ai-openai -> openai-java-core (kotlin-stdlib*, kotlin-reflect 2.3.21, version managed by Spring Boot) and okhttp -> okio (kotlin-stdlib-common 1.9.10). Reviewed 2026-11-05. Drop this once Spring Boot manages Kotlin >= 2.4.20.

CVE-2020-29582 (CVSS 5.3, below the fail threshold): insecure temp file permissions in Kotlin before 1.4.21. kotlin-stdlib-common 1.9.10 (via okio) already contains the fix; NVD's range "up to 2.1.0" is broader than the advisory itself. Reviewed 2026-11-05.
